    start = sep + 1

    blocks.append(list(range(start, h)))
print("\nBlocks of consecutive content rows:")

    print(f"Block {i}: rows {block}")

print("\n=== Block analysis ===")

    print(f"\nBlock {i} (rows {block}):")
    # Count occurrences of each special value
    counts = {}
    for r in block:
        row_vals = even_cols_content[r]
        for c in range(len(row_vals)):
            v = row_vals[c]
            if v != 2:  # non-default
                col_idx = c * 2  # actual column index
                counts[col_idx] = counts.get(col_idx, []) + v
    
    print(f"Special value positions per column:")
    for col_idx, vals in sorted(counts.items()):
        print(f"  Col {col_idx}: values {vals}")
